scientific_boundary.primary_target: Ministry of Finance government public debt portfolio under the same national-legislation boundary used by the published portfolio cost and debt-risk indicators, excluding temporary financing where the source definition excludes it
scientific_boundary.external_diagnostic_only: Eurostat Maastricht general-government gross debt and apparent cost; this boundary must not be substituted for the MoF direct government-debt portfolio boundary

event_semantics.MATURITY: contractual principal maturity; not automatically a refinancing or repricing event
event_semantics.REFINANCING: observed replacement financing linked to the represented matured/refinanced principal; linkage may not be inferred from aggregate financing needs
event_semantics.CONTRACTUAL_REFIXING: rate reset on an existing floating/indexed instrument without principal maturity
event_semantics.NEW_ISSUANCE: new borrowing; not automatically the new rate for any specific maturing principal
event_semantics.PORTFOLIO_REFERENCE: published aggregate or sub-portfolio measure used only for reconciliation

gate_1_ledger_completeness.rule: Coverage is computed only on the exact MoF portfolio boundary and exact testing period. Issuance size, redemption schedules and strategy targets do not count as observed opening/repriced principal.

gate_2_balance_reconciliation.rule: Instrument/block principal must sum to the published matched-boundary stock within tolerance before portfolio-cost reconstruction.

gate_3_portfolio_cost_reconstruction.rule: Only source-compatible interest-cost definitions and same-boundary principals may be weighted.

gate_4_parameter_identification.rule: A repricing share or transition parameter is estimable only from observed matched repriced principal and matched old/new or reset rates. No aggregate residual parameter may absorb missing instrument, currency or fixed/floating allocations.

gate_5_prospective_confirmation_for_vali.rule: Historical reconstruction can at most support CANDIDATE. VALIDATED additionally requires a prospectively reserved later period containing non-zero repricing/reset events to pass the same boundary, completeness and portfolio-cost tolerances without respecification after seeing that period.

status_rules.DEFERRED: Any boundary/completeness gate fails before defensible estimation, or reconstruction would require prohibited synthetic allocation.
status_rules.CANDIDATE: Ledger completeness, balance reconciliation, historical portfolio-cost reconstruction and parameter identification pass prospectively frozen criteria, but prospective confirmation has not yet passed.
status_rules.VALIDATED: CANDIDATE requirements plus the prospectively reserved confirmation period pass without post-observation respecification.
